featured_reviews.name: nisha bagla
featured_reviews.review_text:
"Not Worth Staying – Hygiene Issues, Unprofessional Service & Poor Facilities"

I stayed at this club recently, and while the exterior looks clean and well-maintained, the reality is far from that. The moment night falls, you’ll be attacked by bed bugs, mosquitoes, and even flies in the bathroom. To make matters worse, the bathroom ceilings are damaged, and the rooms have an unpleasant odor. This place rates itself as a 4-star property, but honestly, it doesn’t even deserve 1 star.

Additionally, the service is abysmal. There was no one at the reception to receive or attend to guests when we arrived. The hotel was badly understaffed, with only 2 people managing the entire property. This is completely unacceptable for any hospitality business.

On a positive note, the food at Saffron Grill was decent, and the staff, though polite, couldn’t make up for the overall poor experience. I would not recommend staying here at all. It’s simply not worth the price or the hassle.

featured_reviews.name: Everything On A Plate EOAP
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked inside on the 1st floor of cosmo square, it's sadly quite easy to miss!

It was one of the first playzones in the area so it was a rage. But now with the new zones emerging this space may fall behind.

They have quite a few activities - slides, ball pit, car zoom, swings, wall climbing trampoline etc but it's sadly not maintained. Thought it's not "unclean" the broken ball pit, crumbling sponge does make your heart jitter a bit.

Then again the space is decently sized, rates are a steal, there are some refreshments and the staff (Pranali and Prajwal) here is incredibly attentive and kind. We even bumped into a few regulars and the conversations we overheard sounded like people are really happy with the space.

Ultimately it boils down to what you are willing to overlook and how much fun your kid has. Our kid has a blast but the ball pit will definitely make us do a double take.

name: SYMBIANS Football Club
description:
Symbians Football Club (SFC) is a powerhouse in Maharashtra football, competing in the prestigious Mumbai Super Division League, Palghar, and Thane District Tournaments. SFC also participates in private events like the Leno League and Palghar Youth Football League, showcasing grassroots talent. Focused on holistic development, SFC nurtures young players through structured training, instilling values of teamwork and discipline.

The Symbians Sports Arena, a 6,000-square-foot multi-sport ground, is designed for football and cricket. With a 500-spectator capacity, it serves as a hub for games and training. Together, SFC and the Arena inspire athletes, unite communities, and promote sports excellence in Maharashtra.

featured_reviews.name: 219 Khushi Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Highly Recommended Football Club!

This football club is truly exceptional! From the moment you step in, you can feel the energy, passion, and dedication all around. The coaches are extremely encouraging and focus on each player individually, helping them improve not just technically but also mentally and physically.

The training sessions are dynamic, engaging, and perfectly designed for all age groups. The club maintains excellent discipline while still making every practice session fun and motivating. The teammates are friendly and supportive, creating a real sense of family and teamwork.

The progress I’ve seen—both in skills and confidence—is amazing. If you’re looking for a place where you can grow, learn, and enjoy football to the fullest, this is definitely the club to join!

featured_reviews.name: Yash Mali
featured_reviews.review_text: Symbians Football Club offers an excellent environment for young players to grow both technically and mentally. The coaching staff is dedicated, knowledgeable, and genuinely focused on player development. The training sessions are well-structured, and the club maintains a positive, encouraging atmosphere that helps players build confidence. Their consistent commitment to skill improvement, discipline, and teamwork makes this academy a great choice for anyone serious about football. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Moulik Godavarthi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Symbians FC feels like the place where real football energy lives in Mumbai. The moment you step onto their turf, you can tell they’re serious about the game. The coaching is sharp, the sessions are disciplined, and every drill actually makes you better as a player. No time pass, no chaos — pure football.

What I liked most is the vibe. Players push each other, the coaches actually pay attention, and the environment builds confidence. Whether you’re training for competition or just trying to level up your skills, this club gives you the right mix of intensity and support.

The facilities are well-kept, the ground quality is great, and the whole management treats the sport with respect. It’s the kind of place where you walk in as a player and walk out feeling like an athlete.

featured_reviews.name: Likhith Pranay
featured_reviews.review_text: Honestly, this club is one of the most well-rounded and exciting football club. The vibe around the club is just different. They have a perfect mix of talented young players and experienced coaches, and you can actually see how well they connect on the pitch. The academy is solid. They keep producing talented youngsters who actually get chances in the first team. Not many clubs do that properly, so it’s cool to see young players growing and becoming important for the club.

featured_reviews.name: Harshit Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: This football academy is an excellent platform for nurturing new talent. The coaches are highly supportive and focus on developing both skills and confidence in young players. It’s a great place for aspiring footballers to grow and achieve their potential

featured_reviews.name: Bhavya Rai Batra
featured_reviews.review_text: Symbians FC is a top-tier football club in Mumbai. The coaching is excellent, the facilities are great, and the environment pushes you to improve every day. Whether you’re a beginner or looking to compete, this club has the right balance of intensity and support. Highly recommend for anyone serious about football!

featured_reviews.name: Prithvi Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: Symbians Football Club shows strong commitment to player development and teamwork. featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an awesome time at Timezone in Capital Mall, Vasai East. The VR ride was truly out of this world. I chose the Halloween game, and it was so immersive and spooky. I felt like. The VR headset and equipment were super clean and comfortable, and the whole setup was well maintained. Each ride lasted about 10 minutes, which was just the right length for me. At ₹200 per person per ride, it's a bit on the pricier side, but the experience is definitely worth it.

The VR rides were the highlight of our visit, but the arcade games were also fun and engaging. The bowling alley, though small, was still enjoyable, and I had a good time. The only downside was that the place can get quite crowded, especially on weekends, and the AC sometimes struggles to keep up

Despite the occasional crowd and warm temperatures, I had a great time at Timezone Capital Mall
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Ranajit, we’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed the immersive VR experience and had a fun visit! featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: We went here primarily for bowling. We purchased an offline card. We paid 3100 plus tax(3600) and got 3500 as balance. We also got a BOGO offer in bowling. We selected VIP bowling and it had animation and graphics on the bowling floor and of course the normal bowling was crowded. They have very good combination of arcade and normal games and we had fun here. Staff was very helpful and we had some issues with machine and my card got swiped multiple times. They understood my issue and offered me different games. We collected lot of tickets which acts like a currency for some of the items. They have a free bowling round on birthdays. featured_reviews.name: Saunskaar Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited SHOTT Mumbai for my college event, and it was an amazing experience. The venue offers a fantastic arcade, a bowling area, a section for drinks and snacks, and dedicated rooms for parties and events. The vibe here is superb, and the staff is incredibly cooperative, making the experience even better. If you're looking for a fun and lively place for entertainment or events, SHOTT Mumbai is definitely worth checking out!

featured_reviews.name: Pratap Vashodiya
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Shott Mumbai and had an amazing time playing their arcade games. The place has a lively vibe with a wide variety of games, from racing and shooting to classic arcade machines. What made my experience even more exciting was winning bonus tickets while playing. The thrill of collecting tickets after each win kept me fully engaged and added a fun competitive edge. Eventually, I redeemed my tickets and got a cool gift, which made the whole experience even more rewarding. The staff was friendly and helpful, guiding me through the games and redemption process. Overall, it was a fun-filled and memorable outing, perfect for hanging out with friends or just enjoying some solo gaming time. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for entertainment in Mumbai.
